present_inputs: Reuse archived iq, true_phase_rad, raw_recovered_phase_rad, noise_native and true_center_shift_circle from ellipse_phase_controls. Verify source artifact hashes.
absent_inputs: Remove exactly 0.08*sin(2*pi*1.2*t) from stored true phase. Reevaluate the same frozen observation law at this phase, preserving affine matrix, center drift, noise samples and deformation parameters. Refit first30s with the same immutable solver/guards.
resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly(phase,1,5), entire60s trace, original default filter and padding
recovered_phase: Use unaligned production cumulative-conjugate phase. Constant phase offset and global sign do not change detrended FFT power.
readout: Extract the exact spectrum, freq, band, prediction assignments from process() in run_synchronized_real_pilot.py by AST, using scipy.signal linear detrend, periodic Hann512, rFFT4096,45<=bpm<=150 and first argmax tie rule.
normal_positive_readout: For present only, each window has finite spectrum and abs(prediction-72)<=1.171875bpm (half native resolution). A run is normal only if calibration accepted and all3 windows meet this fixed reference. No amplitude or prominence gate added to the original reader.
target_amplitude: 2*abs(sum(detrended_trace*Hann*exp(-2j*pi*1.2*n/20)))/sum(Hann), exact1.2Hz DTFT, unnormalized phase radians; also save nearest FFT-bin amplitude and strongest amplitude within72+/-1.171875bpm
target_power: Sum original FFT power in72+/-1.171875bpm and fraction of45-150bpm power, descriptive on the zero-padded grid
competing_peaks: All local maxima in the fixed HR band, including endpoint maxima if >= adjacent bin; normalized amplitude=2*sqrt(power)/sum(Hann). Strongest competitor excludes72+/-2.34375bpm. Retain empty competitors as null.
boundary_peaks: Save both band endpoint amplitudes, strongest bins within2.34375bpm of45 and150, and selected peak flags for endpoint and boundary regions.
retention: Retain all360 windows, every source/condition/seed/noise combination, calibration failures and low-amplitude mask fractions. No posthoc time trimming or window removal.
aggregation: Summarize each seed/noise/condition/source over3 overlapping windows, then summarize by case/noise. Zero-noise seeds are deterministic duplicates. No window/seed pseudo-replication, p-values or confidence intervals treating overlaps as independent.
absent_scoring: No trueHR/MAE assigned to absent condition. Report output frequencies, amplitudes, competitors, boundary flags and descriptive proximity to72; pair amplitudes to present. An argmax output alone is insufficient for a false-detection claim.
exit: For present runs, truth normal + recovery abnormal supports downstream distortion from phase recovery under this observation law; both abnormal prioritizes the reader; truth normal + recovery normal despite large phase RMSE shows phase-reference accuracy and this72bpm task differ. Retain recovery-only normal category if observed. After this run, geometry metrics have QC scope and real-six remain development material, with other27 retained.
run_scope: One frozen local synthetic readout run, no new real signal arrays or model training; all parameters inherited or declared here before results.
